tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI and ServiceNow are deepening their alliance to embed artificial intelligence agents in enterprise workflows with new tools and features, confirmed by BigGo Finance.
A woman died after allegedly following ChatGPT's advice to change her medication dosage, and her parents are suing OpenAI, reported by The Times of India.
Google DeepMind and Google Cloud have deployed artificial intelligence across Singapore's health system for research and clinical care, confirmed by TradingView.
Tencent is expanding its artificial intelligence reach globally via Southeast Asia, targeting 150 plus countries with its WorkBuddy agent, confirmed by South China Morning Post.
Doosan Robotics narrowed its Q3 loss as its EOL business drove revenue growth, with EOL sector revenue rising 55 percent to 5 dollars, confirmed by Chosunbiz.
